events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' Turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Debut Album Impact
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music. What's your favourite track from this absolute game-changer?

events.title: Woodstock Festival: 57 Years On
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15 to 18, 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, a field in New York became the epicentre of a generation. The spirit of Woodstock lives on – what's your most iconic memory or performance from the festival?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42; he would have been 91 this year.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering The King. Forty-nine years since we lost Elvis Presley, but his music and legendary status endure. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur tragically died on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25; he would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Tupac's Influence
angles.copy: Paying tribute to Tupac Shakur, who left us far too soon 30 years ago today. His lyrical genius and impact on hip-hop culture are still felt worldwide.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, the legendary guitarist, died on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27; he would have been 84 this year.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who passed away 56 years ago today. His guitar mastery redefined music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history! What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Hynde's Enduring Voice
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Her distinctive voice and songwriting with The Pretenders continue to inspire. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic former frontman of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Rock N Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! The rock 'n' roll star with an unmistakable swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment or song?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Single Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic single 'Imagine' in the UK on October 24, 1971.

angles.name: Timeless Message of Imagine
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released the powerful and timeless anthem 'Imagine'. Its message still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The Original iPod: 25 Years On
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod on October 23, 2001.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember this? Twenty-five years ago, the first iPod launched and completely changed how we listen to music. Did you have one of the originals?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating 007 since 'Dr. No' premiered on this day in 1962. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering the incredible John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: John Cleese, the legendary British comedian and actor, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us some of the most iconic comedy moments. What's your favourite?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Diversity
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. What are your standout tracks from this double LP?
